evidence: Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) by our employees, subcontractors and third parties engaged by us could have an adverse impact on our business and operations.
As of the date of this filing, we have developed a policy regarding the use of AI and predictive analytics tools.

There is a risk that such AI tools (or AI tools used without Company approval) will be used in a manner that does not adhere to our AI policy and/or may be misused by our employees, subcontractors, or other third parties engaged by us.
Threats can come from many sources, including... artificial intelligence enabled attacks.
ai_positioning.summary: AWR adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, ayant développé une politique de gouvernance pour encadrer l'usage interne des outils IA (ChatGPT, Claude, Co-Pilot) afin de mitiger les risques de fuite de données confidentielles et les attaques informatiques amplifiées par l'IA.
